taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-20, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 64.6 | 2.65 | 2.65
2 | 775.4 | 0.67 | 3.32
3 | 110.3 | 1.09 | 4.41
4 | 222.5 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation for the given VES station, we look at the resistivity values for each layer in depth order:

- Layer 1 ($r_1$): 64.6 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 2 ($r_2$): 775.4 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 3 ($r_3$): 110.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
- Layer 4 ($r_4$): 222.5 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$

We evaluate each group of three consecutive layers based on the provided rules:
1. **Group 1 (Layers 1-2-3):** $r_1=64.6, r_2=775.4, r_3=110.3$.
   Comparing the values: $64.6 < 775.4$ and $775.4 > 110.3$. 
   Since $r_1 < r_2 > r_3$, this corresponds to the letter **K**.

2. **Group 2 (Layers 2-3-4):** $r_2=775.4, r_3=110.3, r_4=222.5$.
   Comparing the values: $775.4 > 110.3$ and $110.3 < 222.5$. 
   Since $r_2 > r_3 < r_4$, this corresponds to the letter **H**.

For a 4-layer model, we have $4 - 2 = 2$ letters. Combining them in depth order, we get **KH**.

{"curve_type": "KH"}
